description: This source file defines the MultiMapExtractAdapter class which implements the io.opentracing.propagation.TextMap interface. It acts as an adapter to extract properties from a Vert.x MultiMap object for tracing purposes, specifically within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.description: An adapter implementing TextMap for extracting trace metadata from a Vert.x MultiMap.
